name: 3gpp-scout
description: Search 3GPP specifications, TDocs and meeting decisions with citations.

interface.longDescription: 3GPP Scout helps telecom engineers, standards delegates and consultants find answers in 3GPP specifications, meeting contributions (TDocs) and meeting decisions. Ask about a clause, a protocol message or a company's position, and get excerpts with spec number, version and section so you can check the source. Requires a Scout account; you sign in on install. 3GPP Scout is an independent product of SuperPenguin and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by 3GPP, ETSI or any 3GPP Organizational Partner. 3GPP™ is a trade mark of ETSI registered for the benefit of its Members and of the 3GPP Organizational Partners. Excerpts are quoted for reference and the 3GPP documents govern.
